fusions.name: Pronged Pin
fusions.desc: Throws a two-pronged shard at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Branch Point
fusions.desc: Sends a branching spine into the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage. It then splits to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 70% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 40% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Spreading Growth
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. Your armour rises by 4% at all times.
